[[File:The Pony Engine, by Mary C. Jacobs (1910).png|thumb|The Pony Engine, by Mary C. Jacobs (1910)]]
'''''[[w:The Little Engine That Could|The Little Engine That Could]]''''' is an American folktale (existing in the form of several illustrated children's books and films) that became widely known in the United States after publication in 1930 by [[w:Platt & Munk|Platt & Munk]]. Earlier versions of the story date back to 1902, including one published in 1906 as "[[wikisource:Story of the Engine that Thought It Could|Story of the Engine That Thought It Could]]."
 
* I think I can. I think I can, I think I can.

* I thought I could. I thought I could, I thought I could.
